summary: Transforms a point by a 3x3 matrix plus translation, then copies a 3-dword result. First calls RideHeightDelta on the this object to fill the three component locals v7/v8/v9. It then computes the dot product of those three components against each of the three matrix coefficient groups (at this+13488/13492/13496, this+13500/13504/13508, this+13512/13516/13520), adds the translation components (this+13524/13528/13532), and writes the three results into a2. Finally it copies the three dwords at this+13536/13540/13544 into a3 and returns the second of those dwords. Called from eleven sites including AIRacingLine, VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate, SessionStateTransition and VehicleYawRotationRecoveryController.

local_names.a2: output float[3] for the transformed point

operations.description: Call RideHeightDelta with (this, &v7) to fill the three local components v7/v8/v9.
Add the translation components to the results: a2[0] += this+13524, a2[1] += this+13528, a2[2] += this+13532.
Copy the dwords at this+13536, this+13540 and this+13544 into a3[0], a3[1], a3[2].
